item.title: Lourdes Downs North Schuylkill 49-32 in Schuylkill League Semifinals
item.description: After trailing early, Our Lady of Lourdes seized control in the middle quarters and pulled away for a 49-32 victory over North Schuylkill in the Schuylkill League Girls’ Basketball Semifinals at Martz Hall. item.title: North Schuylkill Band Boosters Receive Community Foundation Grant for New Percussion Equipment
item.description: The North Schuylkill Band Boosters Association has received a boost to its music program thanks to funding from the Schuylkill Area Community Foundation. The organization was recently awarded a $988.00 grant, which was used to support the North Schuylkill High School Band’s Mallet Percussion Project. item.title: Former Synagogue Collapses in Mahanoy City, No Injuries Reported
item.description: Emergency crews were called to the scene of a building collapse Thursday night after a former synagogue gave way along a borough street, narrowly missing nearby vehicles.
